_comment: Sample content for the call centre's demo: an escape route through the default Mandelbox (scale -2.09, fold 1, radii 0.7/1), found offline with the distance estimator. Every leg clears the fractal by >= 7 m (1 unit = 1 km) and the shortcuts to the exit are blocked. The game owns real world content; this file only drives call_center/demo.tscn and the tests.

features.name: The Grand Inversion Sphere
features.blurb: The sphere-fold boundary. Anything inside the minimum radius gets inflated by a factor of about two. Do not touch.

features.name: Ramanujan's Taxicab Rank
features.blurb: A wall of folded lattice. There are no taxis. There have never been taxis.

features.name: The Transcendental Skylight
features.blurb: An irrational ceiling. Never repeats, never ends, never lets the light in.

features.name: The Recursive Cul-de-sac
features.blurb: A dead end that loops back into itself at every scale except this one, which is why it is the way out.

features.name: The Box-Fold Bypass
features.blurb: Where the box fold reflects space back on itself. Tight squeeze; mind the clamp.

features.name: The Kaprekar Roundabout
features.blurb: Every path eventually ends up here. This is not as helpful as it sounds.

features.name: The Lipschitz Narrows
features.blurb: The narrowest stretch of the way out. The distance estimate here is honest but unforgiving.

features.name: The Outer Aperture
features.blurb: An opening in the cube's +X face with ordinary space beyond. A perfect number, and a perfect place to leave.

features.name: The Egress Rift
features.blurb: A tear back into ordinary three-space. Fly into it to complete the jump.
